attributes.body_ja:
「やら」は日本語（にほんご）の副助詞（ふくじょし）の一（ひと）つで、(A) をはっきりと断定（だんてい）せず、曖昧（あいまい）に示（しめ）すときに使（つか）われます。これは「など」のような表現（ひょうげん）にも似（に）ており、「(A) やそのようなもの」といった意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。

「やら」は動詞（どうし）の辞書形（じしょけい）や、名詞（めいし）、イ形容詞（けいようし）、ナ形容詞（けいようし）の語幹（ごかん）に付（つ）けて使（つか）われます。「(A) やら (B) やら」の形（かたち）で繰（く）り返（かえ）して使（つか）う場合（ばあい）、(A) と (B) は同（おな）じ品詞（ひんし）になることが多（おお）いですが、話（はな）し手（て）がさまざまな感情（かんじょう）を例（れい）に挙（あ）げるときには異（こと）なる品詞（ひんし）が使（つか）われることもあります。

「とか」と比（くら）べると、「やら」は (A) と (B) を含（ふく）む物事（ものごと）の範囲（はんい）をより強調（きょうちょう）する表現（ひょうげん）です。そのため、「やら」で挙（あ）げられた (A) と (B) は「ほかにもいろいろある中（なか）のほんの一部（いちぶ）に過（す）ぎない」というニュアンスが強（つよ）くなります。こうした理由（りゆう）から、「やら」は「たくさんあって大変（たいへん）だ」「状況（じょうきょう）が複雑（ふくざつ）だ」という話（はな）し手（て）の気持（きも）ちを表（あらわ）すときにもよく使（つか）われます。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

「のやら～のやら」という形（かたち）で使（つか）われるときは、話（はな）し手（て）が (A) か (B) のどちらが正（ただ）しいのか判断（はんだん）できない中（なか）で、可能性（かのうせい）のある選択肢（せんたくし）を挙（あ）げていることを表（あらわ）します。そのため、(A) と (B) には反対（はんたい）の意味（いみ）を持（も）つ言葉（ことば）が入（はい）ることが多（おお）いですが、例外（れいがい）もあります。
attributes.body:
やら is an adverbial particle in Japanese which expresses lack of determination or limitation in regard to (A). Due to this, it is very similar to other structures like など, and will often translate as '(A) and so on', or '(A) and the like'.

やら may appear following verbs in their dictionary form, nouns, い-Adjectives, or な-Adjectives. When repeated as (A) やら (B) やら, both (A) and (B) will often be the same type of word, although this is not a limitation when the speaker is expressing various feelings in relation to something.

Compared to とか, やら puts more emphasis on the scope of things within the category of (A) and (B), thus making it sound like (A) and (B) are only a small fraction of many different things within a complex pool of various emotions, actions, etc.

Caution

When appearing as のやら～のやら, this emphasizes that the speaker does not actually know which one out of (A) and (B) is the correct option, and is just presenting both as potential possibilities. Due to this, (A) and (B) will often be antonyms or opposites of some sort in these types of sentences, but not always.

attributes.body: だの and やら～やら are similar in that both are used to list multiple examples of something, but differ in that だの generally has a negative implication, while やら～やら can just be used to provide examples without any particular implication.

first_relatable.title: だの
first_relatable.meaning: Things like, And so on, Or something, And whatnot

second_relatable.title: やら～やら
second_relatable.meaning: Whether or, Things like, And … so on

attributes.body: While both やら～やら and とか～とか list examples, they differ in nuance. やら～やら often has an uncertain tone or a presents contradictory possibilities, e.g. 行くのやら行かないのやら ('whether he's going or not'). とか is more neutral and casual, simply listing examples without a strong nuance of uncertainty.

second_relatable.title: とか～とか
second_relatable.meaning: Among other things, For example, Such as

attributes.body: ～ても～なくても and やら～やら both present multiple possibilities, but ～ても～なくても contrasts something with its negative, e.g. 行っても行かなくてもいい ('Go or don't, it's fine'), while やら～やら loosely lists alternatives, which may include opposites, e.g. 行くのやら行かないのやら ('whether he'll go or not'), or not, e.g. 本やら辞書やら ('things like books and dictionaries').

second_relatable.title: やら～やら
second_relatable.meaning: Whether or, Things like, And … so on

attributes.body: Both たり～たりする and やら～やら list examples of actions, like saying 'doing things like A and B' in English. たり is more neutral, while やら adds a nuance of uncertainty or a wider, less-defined range, suggesting the speaker is listing just some of many possible actions or things.

first_relatable.title: やら～やら
first_relatable.meaning: Whether or, Things like, And … so on

attributes.body: Both や and やら～やら are used to list items or examples from a larger set, and are more common in writing or formal speech than in casual conversation. や is a straightforward way to suggest other similar examples, as in 'A, B, and things like that.' In contrast, やら～やら carries a stronger nuance of uncertainty or possibility, as if the speaker is listing examples that may or may not apply.
